run_scheduler_process: run the SGLang scheduler process with server args, port args, and GPU ranks to manage tensor parallel GPU workers
create_Scheduler: create a Scheduler instance managing a tensor parallel GPU worker with model config, cache, and IPC channels
build_schedule_batch: build a ScheduleBatch from a list of requests for prefill or decode forward passes on the GPU
test_event_loop_normal: test the normal scheduler event loop that receives requests, schedules batches, and runs forward passes
review_abort_request: review the abort_request method that cancels requests across waiting queue, grammar queue, running batch, and disaggregation queues
